parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) that have recorded indications at phase 2 (max_phase_for_ind = 2). Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication and map EFO terms to indication labels. Return chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
